risks.note: The Board's Report describes the business as trading and distribution of iron and steel products primarily sourced from Tata Steel and tractors of John Deere India, so the revenue base rests on continuation of two principal relationships and their commercial terms.

The Board's Report states the trading and distribution business is conducted in the state of Bihar, and the MD&A calls Bihar the principal geography of operations, so demand, competition and policy exposure are concentrated in one state economy.

The MD&A notes base-metal prices including iron ore and steel saw a moderate cyclical recovery only in the latter half of the year and crude oil ranged between USD 70 and USD 85 per barrel; a trading-led model with PVC and freight inputs is exposed to those price swings.
risks.risk: Commodity-price cyclicality across steel and crude-linked inputs

risks.note: The MD&A attributes downstream demand for steel, building materials and farm mechanisation to public capex, the Gati Shakti Master Plan, the National Infrastructure Pipeline, PLI schemes and the Jal Jeevan Mission, and Bihar demand to a record railway allocation and rural-bridge and housing programmes; any moderation in those outlays flows straight into the Company's core verticals.
risks.risk: Reliance on the government capital-expenditure cycle for end demand

risks.note: The MD&A frames calendar 2025 as cautious resilience amid persistent geopolitical tensions and evolving trade-policy realignments, which affect steel trade flows, import competition and input costs.

The MD&A records installed Indian steel capacity crossing 220 MTPA against a National Steel Policy target of 300 MTPA by 2030, while finished steel consumption is around 164 million tonnes, implying a supply-led market whose pricing can compress distributor economics.

drhp.strategies: The Company states a Dividend Distribution Policy that endeavours for fairness, consistency and sustainability while distributing profits to Members, with the policy published on the Company's website. Capital-structure policy during the year was oriented to deleveraging: the movement in borrowings, comprising repayment of long-term borrowings and a reduction in working-capital borrowings, was effected primarily out of the proceeds of the initial public offer, and the Company reports no non-cash changes in liabilities arising from financing activities.
